newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Chase Manhattan Australia profit soars.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Chase Manhattan Australia profit soars.

text.p: Chase Manhattan Bank in Australia said its calendar 1996 pre-tax operating profit rose 34 percent to A$77 million from A$57.2 million a year earlier.
The company, whose parent merged with rival New York-based Chemical Banking Corp last year, did not provide other financial details. The 1996 and 1995 figures include Chemical results.

"All lines of business have contributed to the solid result for 1996. We are particularly pleased with the success of custody, corporate finance, derivatives, capital markets and commodities," Chase managing director in Australia, Scott Reid said. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
